description: A map of numbers unified with an object of strings converts its elements to strings
notes: hashicorp/hcl unifies the object's attribute types as a map first, then unifies that map type with the map of numbers, which gives a map of strings (unifyObjectsAsMaps in cty/convert/unify.go). The spec unifies a map and an object to the object type, whose attribute a is a string. Either way the selected map's element a becomes the string "1".
